what_this_is: Reviewed per-source rulings the registry applies (tools/build_corpus_registry.apply_source_rulings). Each ruling is about the file whose sha256 it names; a file that changed is not ruled. A ruling must agree with any general source-text rule (umat_oti.corpus.source_rulings) that fires on the same file, or the registry build stops. Both rulings below are also reached by a general rule; the ruling supplies the reviewed wording and the evidence beyond the file (deck, repository tree).
